display_name: Tri-SIG-TIME 基于跨接收机分支的部分标签与回波证据
scope: Phase1 ManySig Main split F0, original full reference-response PAMF, three views and fixed local shuffle [0,5,3,6,2,1,4,7]. Two methods x model seeds 2026092701, 2026092702, 2026092703. F0 target is previously exposed. The running rejected-U hard-certificate candidate has only yielded source-training exposure counters when this design is fixed.
initialization: Exact original source-only Tri-SIG-TIME E20 of each seed; then own E10+E20 to fixed E50/11100 updates. Same source L/U, source RX/day, head and existing deployment graph.
controls: Ordinary PL matched to the same F0 inputs
Raw branch partial-label control at equal probe dose
evaluation: Fixed E50, clean plus six practical satellite-ground scenes. DURA-LU primary, DURA-L and raw secondary. Combine disjoint cross_rx and cross_both, 168000 physical packets per scene, cross_date diagnostic. Score independently after all six predictions freeze, then report per scene and seed, TX/RX/day, paired corrections and regressions. Exclude leo_weak.
success: Positive paired three-seed means versus Tri-SIG-TIME on clean and practical-six mean, and positive paired mean versus PL in every scene. Report all seed losses. Stronger all-condition attainment requires each PL scene-by-seed cell positive and confirmation on an independent protocol.
expected_artifacts: Six seven-scene prediction matrices and independent scores
